description: Is this a good price? Give a product (name, model number or eBay item URL) and a price in USD; get where that price sits against today's US eBay listings for it (cheapest, 25th percentile, median, share of listings cheaper) and its 30-day low, with a verdict: great, good, fair or high. Without a price you get the market numbers and an estimated resale value after eBay fees.

price_usd.description: the price you were offered, item + shipping

product.description: e.g. 'RTX 4070', 'WD Red Plus 8TB', or an ebay.com/itm/ URL

name: check_price
